epics.title: User Activity Tracking
epics.description: Allow users to track their physical activities, such as running, walking, or cycling, to monitor their performance over time. This helps users stay consistent and measure their progress in their fitness journey.

user_stories.title: Track Daily Physical Activities
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to track my daily physical activities (e.g., steps, distance, and duration) so that I can monitor my exercise habits.
acceptance_criteria: The app records the duration and distance of activities such as running, walking, or cycling.
The app displays a summary of all activities recorded each day.

user_stories.title: Manual Activity Logging
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to manually log activities that cannot be automatically tracked so that all my workouts are recorded in one place.
acceptance_criteria: Users can manually add details of activities such as yoga or weightlifting.
The manually logged activities appear in the daily summary along with automatically tracked activities.

epics.title: Progress Monitoring and Visualization
epics.description: Provide visual representations of users' activity data to help them easily monitor their fitness progress. Visualizing progress encourages motivation and helps users understand trends and improvements.

user_stories.title: View Weekly and Monthly Progress Reports
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to view my weekly and monthly progress so that I can assess my consistency and improvements over time.
acceptance_criteria: The app generates weekly and monthly summaries of activity data.
The progress reports include charts and graphs for visual representation.

user_stories.title: Receive Achievement Notifications
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to receive notifications when I reach fitness milestones so that I stay motivated.
acceptance_criteria: The app sends a notification when the user reaches a specific goal or personal record.
Notifications are customizable based on user preferences.

epics.title: Fitness Goal Setting
epics.description: Enable users to set personalized fitness goals such as daily steps, calories burned, or workout frequency, to give them a target to work towards and help maintain focus.

user_stories.title: Set and Edit Fitness Goals
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to set and edit my fitness goals so that I can tailor my targets to my current fitness level.
acceptance_criteria: Users can set goals for metrics such as steps, calories burned, and active minutes.
Users can edit their goals at any time, and changes are reflected in their progress tracking.

user_stories.title: Track Goal Achievement
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to track my goal achievement status so that I can see how close I am to reaching my targets.
acceptance_criteria: The app shows progress towards each goal in percentage form.
Users receive updates on how much more effort is needed to reach their goals.

epics.title: Personalized Workout Recommendations
epics.description: Offer personalized workout plans and recommendations based on the user's fitness level, preferences, and goals. This helps users maximize the efficiency of their workouts and achieve their desired outcomes.

user_stories.title: Receive Personalized Workout Suggestions
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to receive personalized workout suggestions based on my fitness level and goals so that I can improve effectively.
acceptance_criteria: The app recommends workouts based on user preferences (e.g., cardio, strength).
Recommendations adapt based on the user's activity history and progress.

user_stories.title: Adjust Workouts Based on Feedback
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to provide feedback on workout difficulty so that the app can adjust future recommendations to suit my needs.
acceptance_criteria: Users can rate the difficulty of a workout after completing it.
The app uses the feedback to adjust the intensity of future recommendations.

epics.title: Wearable Device Integration
epics.description: Integrate with wearable devices to automatically collect fitness data such as heart rate, steps, and calories burned. This provides a more seamless experience for users who want accurate data tracking.

user_stories.title: Connect to Wearable Devices
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to connect my wearable device to the app so that my physical activity data is automatically synced.
acceptance_criteria: The app can connect to popular wearable devices (e.g., smartwatches, fitness bands).
Activity data such as steps, heart rate, and calories burned is automatically updated in the app.

user_stories.title: Sync Data in Real-Time
user_stories.story: As a user, I want the app to sync data from my wearable device in real-time so that I have up-to-date information on my fitness progress.
acceptance_criteria: The app automatically syncs with the wearable device when connected.
Users can view real-time metrics such as current heart rate and step count.

epics.title: Social Media Sharing
epics.description: Enable users to share their fitness activities, achievements, and progress on social media to engage with friends, celebrate milestones, and motivate others.

user_stories.title: Share Activities on Social Media
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to share my completed activities on social media so that I can celebrate my progress with friends.
acceptance_criteria: Users can share details of completed workouts (e.g., distance, duration) to popular social media platforms.
The shared posts include customizable messages and images generated by the app.

user_stories.title: Post Achievements and Milestones
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to post my fitness achievements and milestones on social media so that I can motivate others and receive support.
acceptance_criteria: The app allows users to share milestones (e.g., reaching a goal) as social media posts.
Achievements include celebratory graphics and messages to engage the user's social network.
